description.narrative: UNESCO seeks to build peace through international cooperation in Education, the Sciences and Culture. UNESCO's programmes contribute to the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals defined in Agenda 2030, adopted by the UN General Assembly in 2015.UNESCO’s programme is financed through a mix of assessed contributions and voluntary contributions. Assessed contributions are mandatory contributions due from Member States by virtue of their membership. The scale of assessments for Member States is based on that of the United Nations, with suitable adjustments to take into account the differences in membership between the two organizations. Ireland’s membership contribution to the UNESCO budget is made annually. It is partly paid in euro (to UNESCO, Paris) €618,985.00 and partly paid in US dollars (to UNESCO, New York) $823,926 (€748,435.53)
